Stonefist Rejara is a djaradin located in the Waking Shores. She is part of a Qalashi war party seemingly heading for the Ruby Life Pools. Also part of this party are: Flamebreaker Grella, Scalemelter Dorbane, Brundin the Dragonbane and a Qalashi War Mammoth.

Stonefray Falls is an area located in the Ohn'ahran Plains, directly east of Nokhudon Hold. It consists of several cliffs and waterfalls leading to the sea, and displays the transition between the reddish stone of the Waking Shores and the dark, igneous stone of Nokhudon Hold. On the shoreline below, there is a Tuskarr fishing boat and volleyball net, not far from Khalla and Tuktu's grill. With War Mode enabled, the area is a Free For All and Quacks and Attacks is sometimes available. During the War of the Scaleborn, the area was repeatedly attacked by Fyrakk and his forces, who sought to catch the Obsidian Citadel in a pincher attack with Vyranoth's army in the north. "Stop poking me!", including several possible variants, is a series of exclamations made by many non-player characters over time. It originated from Warcraft: Orcs & Humans, in which, if the player clicked with the cursor on a unit a sufficient number of times, the unit would angrily react back. For orcs, one of these reactions was them saying "stop poking me!", while doing the same to an human unit could result in them asking "why do you keep touching me?!". Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness gave Footmen the voice line "Are you still touching me?", while Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal had Alleria lamenting that "You never touch the other elves like that."
